title: Rubric - Self-Containment
evidence: All 30 criteria were individually assessed. None require the prompt or input files (source_coin_token.png, Bomb.glb, scene_reference.png, gameplay_config.txt) to grade. Every criterion either (a) checks properties of the agent output alone (criteria 1-5, 8-9, 19, 27), (b) compares to 'the corresponding expected file' where the criterion's subject unambiguously identifies which of the 3 expected files to open (criteria 6-7, 10-18, 20-23, 25-26, 29-30), or (c) is a cross-file consistency check within the agent's own output and thus exempt (criteria 24, 28). With 3 expected files, phrases like 'the corresponding expected file' resolve without ambiguity because each criterion's subject names the agent output file being graded (e.g., 'bomb_runtime_log.txt' maps to expected bomb_runtime_log.txt; bomb_blast_frame.png maps to expected bomb_blast_frame.png; project behavior maps to expected Bomb_Chain_Reaction_Godot_Project.zip). 0 of 30 criteria are non-self-contained (0%).
